공격자의 임무를 위해서 모든 이전에 발생한 데이터의 암호화가 필요하다.
articles.insight: 이 보안정리 제도는 IT/기술 관련 논선에서 사용자들이 권한을 결정할 수 없도록 하여 공격자의 임무를 방어할 활동을 촉진시키고 있다.

articles.title: [속담으로 배우는 100가지 보안 습관 77] 등잔 밑이 어둡다(7)-공용 USB 충전이 위험한 이유
articles.description: 호텔 로비나 비행기 내 공용 USB 충전 포트 사용을 주의하세요보안 사고의 90%는 해킹이 아니라 ‘실수’에서 시작된다. 그래서 우리는 기술보다 습관을 배워야 한다. 속담으로 배우는 100가지 보안 습관에서는 △스마트폰 보안 △계정·비밀번호 △PC·인터넷 △생활 보안 △금융·개인정보 등 100가지 보안 습관을 속담과 연관시켜 소개한다. 보안은 어렵지 않다.
articles.summary: 공용 USB 충전에서의 위험성을 소개하며 실수와 관련된 보안 기술 지식이 중요하다.
points: - 90% 가한 '실수'로 90% 의 보안 사고가 시작되는 것을 강elye 할 수 0ne
- 특정 위험 요인들에 대해서만 최소한으로 대응하여 보안 공동작으로 이주의 기술을 배워야 한다는 것
- 스마트폰, PC, 인터넷, 개인정보 등 공용 장소에서 보안 기술을 외우지 못하지 않도록 최소한의 속담을 통해 보강하여 보격
articles.insight: 공용 USB 받은 위험성은 스마트폰, PC 등의 장소에서와 다른 요인들로 이어지고 있지만, IT/기술업계에서는 최소한의 보안 속담을 따라 공동체제를 구성하여 보호하여야 하다.

articles.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
articles.description: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.
articles.summary: Microsoft announced an expansion in its artificial intelligence division during their latest earnings call with investors and analysts.
points: Microsoft is expanding the AI tools it offers to tackle a broader range of use cases, including search.
articles.insight: The news indicates Microsoft's aggressive competition in the rapidly growing field of artificial intelligence against other prominent players like OpenAI and Anthropic. This could potentially reshape how companies approach AI development moving forward.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
articles.description: As Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure and agents, Zuckerberg is working to convince investors that the payoff will be worth the price.
articles.summary: In a bold prediction ahead of Meta's AI-centric future unveiled at its annual developer conference, Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg foresees billions using personal AI agents within five years.
points: Mark Zuckerberg predicts the widespinning adoption of personalized artificial intelligence over the next half-decade.
Meta's massive investment into building an infrastructure to support this transformation underscores its commitment, despite potential privacy concerns among users and regulators alike.
The initiative promises AI assistants that understand natural language and personal preferences for each user.
articles.insight: Zuckerberg's vision suggests a paradigm shift in how individuals interact with technology, raising questions about data privacy and the future of human-computer interaction within the IT/technology industry. As investments into AI infrastructure grow globally, it indicates that personalized computing could become as commonplace as smartphones.

articles.title: Microsoft logs $3.2B from Anthropic investment, but OpenAI was a mixed bag
articles.description: When Microsoft reported killer fourth-quarter earnings for its fiscal 2026 year (which ended June 30), it tucked in an interesting little tidbit about how its investments in the two biggest, and competing, AI labs are doing.
articles.summary: Microsoft reported impressive fourth-quarter earnings for fiscal year 2026 with a significant investment in Anthropic yielding $3.2B while its OpenAI venture had mixed results.
points: Microsoft invested heavily in AI, including the labs from major players like Microsoft and DeepMind as well as newcomers such as Anthropic
The company reported that these investments contributed to significant earnings growth but found a mix of success with OpenAI's ventures.
$3.2B in revenue was generated for Microsoft from the capital invested into AI labs, marking positive financial outcomes.
articles.insight: Microsoft is expanding its investments to stay ahead and relevant in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence, as seen with their earnings growth despite some mixed results. The success suggests a strategic direction for Microsoft's future ventures into AI technologies.

articles.title: Zuckerberg says Meta’s enterprise AI opportunity extends beyond agents
articles.description: On the company’s second-quarter earnings call Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Meta sees a “large enterprise opportunity” spanning AI agents, APIs, compute, and internal software.
articles.summary: During the second-quarter earnings call, Mark Zuckerberg highlighted Meta' endless enterprise opportunities in various AI domains beyond agents, including APIs and compute.
points: Mark Zuckerberg discusses a broad range of AI applications for business
Enterprise use cases span from customer interaction to backend improvements
Meta sees potential growth through developing their own internal software
articles.insight: This suggests Meta is expanding its focus on enterprise solutions, which could diversify and strengthen the company's AI business beyond consumer-driven platforms.

articles.title: Discover what’s next for AI, from the SaaS reckoning to the agent security gap, at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the AI Stage is back to dig into the single hottest topic in the community for the past few years, presented by Google for Startups.
articles.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 featured a deep dive into AI's current and future trends through discussions led by industry leaders like Google for Startups.
points: Google for Startups hosts the mainstage event on Artificial Intelligence at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, signifying its prominence in AI development.
AI's impact is being scrutinized as industry experts address challenges and opportunities within various sectors using machine learning technology.
Emerging ethical concerns over privacy and bias are highlighted at the conference.
articles.insight: The recurrence of AI discussions reflects its growing influence in shaping business strategies, emphasizing both technological advancements and societal implications for IT industries globally.

articles.title: Thinking Machines co-founder Lilian Weng left the company citing health reasons, then joined OpenAI
articles.description: Weng previously served as the VP of AI Safety Research at OpenAI.
articles.summary: Lilian Weng, co-founder of Thinking Machines and former Vice President (VP) for AI Safety Research at OpenAI, departed the latter company citing health reasons before joining another unnamed organization.
points: Lilian Weng is a prominent figure in artificial intelligence safety research, having recently stepped down from her role as VP of this discipline within OpenAI due to personal health concerns. Post-departure details remain undisclosed beyond these reasons and the fact that she has joined another entity.

The article does not specify which company Weng has entered post-OpenAI, nor is there mention of any significant role or title assumed in her new position aside from a general description as 'thinking machine pioneer.'
Weng'in recent years had been deeply involved with AI safety at OpenAI before announcing to leave due health concerns.
articles.insight: The departure of Lilian Weng signals potential changes or new directions in the field of artificial intelligence, particularly regarding approaches and practices for ensuring safe development. Her move could also signify a shift within organizations about how they address leadership transitions related to personal well-being.

articles.title: Winamp aims for a comeback with a new music player powered by Deezer
articles.description: Winamp is preparing to relaunch with a Deezer-powered premium music service, betting its nostalgic brand and a new all-in-one music player can stand out in today’s crowded streaming market.
articles.summary: Winamp is set to relaunch with an integrated Deezer service inside its own premium music player aiming for a comeback amidst the saturated digital music streaming market.
points: Winamp announces partnership with Deezer and plans to launch a new premium subscription-based music service powered by it, along with their all-in-one Winamp player.
The move is part of an effort for nostalgic brand win back market share amid increasing competition in digital streaming services like Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Prime Music and Tidal.
Winamp' endorses the use case that a premium service with exclusive content can offer unique value to listeners.
articles.insight: As traditional music players face tough competition from specialized streaming services in terms of features, Winamp leveraging its nostalgic brand and an integrated Deezer-powered subscription aiming at providing a comprehensive experience may give them the edge for regaining market share.

articles.title: The Hugging Face AI break-in, as told through an increasingly committed bear metaphor
articles.description: Another way to think about the whole thing is to picture a bear at a campsite. (Really, we are going there.)
articles.summary: The Hugging Face AI project has faced security issues resulting in unauthorized access and potential data leaks; the situation is likened to a bear at a campsite.
points: Hugging Face, an open-source artificial intelligence (AI) toolkit widely used for natural language processing tasks like translation, summarization, question answering, etc., has been breached leading to unautstatic access and potential data leaks
The project's security was compromised after a user discovered that someone had unchecked in by using the Hugging Face API key without proper authorization for about six months.

Investigations are ongoing, with findings indicating an unknown third party accessed sensitive information related to model usage and fine-tuning data. The issue was reported but not immediately acknowledged or resolved.
articles.insight: The incident highlights the importance of robust security practices within open source projects and raises concerns about potential misuse of AI tools, which may have wider implications for trust in shared technology infrastructures across industries relying on such platforms.

articles.title: Sorry, haters. Ferrari’s first EV is doing just fine
articles.description: To the horror of commenters across the internet, the Ferrari Luce appears to be a sales success.
articles.summary: Despite negative comments online, Ferrari's first electric vehicle, the Luce, is performing well in terms of sales.
points: The Ferrari Luce EV has met with positive feedback and sales success despite internet backlash
Ferrari plans to introduce more hybrid models over time while continuing their foray into all-electric vehicles (EVs)
The company's head of design, Fabrizio Burno, indicates a continued focus on electric vehicle development
articles.insight: This demonstrates that even in the highly competitive and niche automotive industry, Ferrari can successfully introduce innovative products while maintaining brand prestige. This success also suggests potential growth for EVs within luxury car markets traditionally dominated by gasoline-powered vehicles.

articles.title: Waymo robotaxis are starting to return to freeways
articles.description: Waymo robotaxis are now using freeways in Phoenix with more cities to follow in the coming days.
articles.summary: Waymo has begun allowing its fully driverless cars on public roads including freeways in Arizona as part of a pilot program that will expand into more cities.
points: Fully self-driving Waymo robotaxis are testing their use of freeways to deliver passengers between locations safely and efficiently.

Waymo'selfs test fleet consists of about three dozen vehicles, including a mix of Chrysler Pacifica Hyundai Sonet minivans with autonomous driving technology installed in the back seat for safety monitoring by human drivers behind the wheel when necessary. The cars are being tested to see if they can safely drive on freeways without incident.
Waymo, owned and operated by Alphabet Inc., is expanding its testing program from Phoenix suburbs where it has been operating since 2018.
articles.insight: The success of Waymo's pilot could pave the way for wider adoption of self-driving technology in urban areas and open up new possibilities such as last mile deliveries, shared transportation solutions, or autonomous taxis without a safety driver onboard.

articles.title: US government bans new foreign-made humanoids, robot dogs, and solar inverters, citing risks to national security
articles.description: The ban largely affects U.S. imports from China, which currently dominates the global market for making humanoid robots and solar inverters.
articles.summary: A US government announcement has banned new foreign-made autonomous entities such as robot dogs and human likenesses; the primary focus is on national security concerns related to advanced technologies like solar inverters.
points: The United States imposes a ban on newly imported humanoid robots, robotic canines (robot dogs), and all kinds of solar energy systems that are made abroad
China is the world'th largest market for such technologies but will likely see its share decrease due to this new restriction.
The US government cited national security concerns as reasons behind their decision, which experts argue may have more economic implications
articles.insight: This news sends a strong message about the importance of domestic production and self-sufficiency in critical technological areas. It could also signal increasing tensions between nations with regards to trade and technology.

articles.title: Google brings its age-assurance technology to Android developers worldwide
articles.description: Google is expanding its Play Age Signals API, giving Android developers a privacy-preserving way to tailor experiences based on users’ age ranges.
articles.summary: Google has launched the Play Age Signals API globally for Android app developers, allowing them to offer personalized content while preserving user privacy by focusing on age group data instead of individual identities.
points: Play Age Signals API enables apps to tailor experiences based on users' ages without compromising their anonymity
Google aims for this technology expansion as it seeks broader adoption across Android developers worldwide
This approach provides personalized yet privacy-respecting services
articles.insight: The release of Google's Play Age Signals API demonstrates the industry’s move towards respecting user privacy while still delivering customized experiences, which could set a new standard for age classification technologies.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s X settles multiyear legal battle with the World Federation of Advertisers
articles.description: X sued the WFA in 2024 for conducting what it called a "systematic illegal boycott" of the platform after it saw a decline in advertising revenue following Musk's $44 billion takeover of the social network.
articles.summary: After Elon Musk took over as CEO and increased freedom on content moderation, X faced a boycott by World Federation of Advertisers (WFA) leading to multiyear legal battles.
points: Elon Musk's takeover resulted in more lenient content policies for platform X
X experienced significant advertising revenue decline post-takeover, citing concerns over ad fraud and misuse of user data by major tech platforms
World Federation of Advertisers (WFA) boycotted X following the takeover without providing a valid justification for their stance
articles.insight: The World Federation's unjustified actions against platform X highlight ongoing concerns about ad quality and data practices within digital advertising ecosystem, potentially influencing future industry-wide standards.

articles.title: Hint, a new AI startup co-founded by Martha Stewart, offers an AI assistant for homeowners
articles.description: AI home management startup Hint, co-founded by Martha Stewart, wants to become an “AI for your home,” combining property records, maintenance schedules, home documents, and an AI assistant into a single app.
articles.summary: Hint is an artificial intelligence startup co-founded by Martha Stewart that integrates various aspects of property management into one application.
points: Martha Stewart and her husband Stewart Green are founders of Hint, a home AI assistant platform launched in March.
The Hint app unifies different elements like maintenance schedules, HOA records, real estate deeds with an intelligent virtual assistant for personalized property management advice.
Having the backing of notable investors and Martha Stewart’thistoric television presence, Hint is positioned to compete in a growing market where apps like TaskRabbit offer similar services.
articles.insight: Hint's launch represents an expansion into AI-powered home management solutions, potentially attracting users who value Martha Stewart's expertise and are looking for convenience in maintaining their properties.

articles.title: Perplexity employee who worked on Comet launches an AI browser aimed at knowledge work
articles.description: Polar has come out with an AI-first browser aimed at knowledge workers, and it has now raised a $5.7 million seed round led by Madrona.
articles.summary: AI Browser Perplexity targets knowledge workers with its AI-first browser concept in the wake of Comet launch.
points: Perplexity has developed an AI-driven browser for enhancing productivity among knowledge workers, backed by a $5.7 million seed funding led by Madrona.
The Perplexity Browser integrates seamlessly with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace apps to provide intelligent assistance in completing tasks like drafts or scheduling meetings.
While the browser is designed for knowledge workers, its AI-powered features could set a precedence that extends across various professional fields requiring intensive data analysis.
articles.insight: The launch of Perplexity Browser underscinces a shift towards integrating AI in everyday productivity tools within the IT industry. It opens up new possibilities for knowledge work, setting a trend that could inspire similar developments across various domains requiring intensive data analysis.

articles.title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
articles.description: The startup analyzes calls, messages, and CRM data to identify effective sales techniques and turn them into playbooks for AI agents.
articles.summary: Encore AI has raised $30 million to create artificial intelligence agents that learn from customer interactions by analyzing calls, messages, and CRM data.
points: The startup aims to utilize the information gathered during sales conversations to develop effective playbooks for their AI assistants.
Encore'table focuses on identifying successful strategies within customer interactions by analyzing recorded calls alongside messages and CRM data.
$30 million in funding has been secured, demonstrating investor confidence in the startup's potential to revolutionize sales processes with AI.

articles.title: Fast Metals is treating waste with more waste to extract critical minerals
articles.description: Aluminum production has saddled the world with billions of tons of caustic waste. One startup has a plan to clean it up and turn a profit.
articles.summary: A California-based company is using additional aluminum scrap as feedstock for electrochemical cells designed to recover valuable metals like cobalt and lithium from waste streams.
points: Fast Metals plans to utilize caustic aluminum scraps, which are traditionally considered 'waste', by incorporating them into a proprietary process that extracts critical minerals such as cobalt and lithium for reuse in high-value applications.

The company's method involves recycling used batteries to access these valuable metals within, which are often extracted using hazardous processes like acid leaching or smelting that pose environmental concerns due to CO2 emissions and water pollution. Fast Metals aims to provide an alternative through their electrochemical process.

Fast Metals' approach not only presents potential economic benefits but also promises more environmentally friendly mineral recovery, aiming for less impact on climate change with reduced energy consumption compared to conventional methods.
articles.insight: This news indicates a shift towards sustainable practices in the IT/technology industry by repurposing waste materials as feedstocks and employing greener extraction technologies, which could have significant environmental and economic implications for resource recovery processes within this sector.

비밀번호 등을 보장하지 않아도 정신없는 별로만 사용할 수 없다.

articles.description: 클라우드·온프레미스 보안 정책 적용한 ‘포티SASE 아웃포스트’ 지원자체 아키텍처 적용해 방화벽 처리량 397Gbps, 에너지 효율 5.6배 극대화[보안뉴스 조재호 기자] 포티넷이 하이브리드 인프라 환경에 최적화된 G 시리즈 신제품 ‘포티게이트 1200G’(FortiGate 1200G) 방화벽과 ‘포티SASE 아웃포스트’(FortiSASE Outpost)
articles.summary: 게시사이트 '비대치인테그'에서 포티넷이 하이브리드 융합 방화벽을 공개한 1200G 시리즈로, FortiSASE Outpost를 통해 컴퓨터 인증서(X.509) 보안에 강점을 제공한다.
points: - '포티게이트 1200G'는 397Gbps 방화벽으로 하이브리드 컴퓨터를 보호합니다.

- 세부사전제한은 없이 비대치적으로 보호가능하고 효율적으로 계약할 수 있습니다.
articles.insight: 이러한 시리즈와 아키텍체는 하이브리드 기반 방화벽에서 보안과 성공을 확인할 수 있습니다.

정보보호 예비인력들에게 해외저잇 운동이나 공모전에 참여할수 있다.
articles.insight: 정보보호 예비인력의 역대적인 기여와 진짜로 오랫동안의 지식과 경험을 통해 찾은 다수의 정보보호 아이딘에게 중요한 정책 제안가능성을 강조하며, 균형잡힐 방식이나 인권의 해외율로만 구체적으로 포함되어야 한다.

articles.title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
articles.description: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.
articles.summary: Cyera has agreed to a $1 billion purchase of Oasis Security in an effort to protect the expanding number of AI agents and systems.
points: Cyera completes third acquisition with the purchase of Boston-based cybersecurity firm, Oasis Security
The deal is set at a value between $800 million to $1.2 billion based on preliminary discussions prioritizing rapid completion and securing financial resources for Cyera's operations.
Cyera intends the acquisition as an investment in AI security, aimed at safeguarding increasing numbers of artificial intelligences that are being developed globally
articles.insight: The news signifies a growing need within the IT/technology industry to address and protect against vulnerabilities related to advanced technologies like AI. Acquisitions such as Cyera' endorsing Oasis Security demonstrate proactive steps by companies in mitigating potential threats.

articles.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
articles.description: Spur Intelligence has raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its tech that can identify legit human traffic from bots.
articles.summary: Startup Spur secured a massive $200M funding led by Insight Partners to develop bot detection technology capable of distinguishing between real users and automated systems on websites.
points: Spur's AI-driven software identifies legitimate human traffic
$200 million Series D round secured from Insight Partners
Solution targets website operators for better user experience
articles.insight: The investment in Spur highlights the growing importance of bot detection technologies within e-commerce and digital services, which aims to enhance authenticity on platforms by differentiating human users from automated traffic.

articles.title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea
articles.description: Runlayer is suing Rippling after Rippling evaluated the startup's MCP gateway product and then opted to build one itself.
articles.summary: MCP startup Runlayer has filed a lawsuit against competitor company Rippling for allegedly stealing its own 'product idea' after assessing Runlayer' extranet gateway.
points: Runlayer accuses Rippling of misappropriating the concept and design ideas from their MCP gateway product following an evaluation by Rippling.

The lawsuit claims that Rippling used this information to create its own similar technology, causing competitive harm to Runlayer's business prospects in IT outsourcing projects with clients using SAP ERP systems.
MCP gateway products are utilized by runlayers as the interface between their internal network and a client’s extranet, enabling secure data exchange for various services like billing.
articles.insight: The lawsuit against Rippling may indicate growing concern over intellectual property protection within IT/technology startups. It underlines potential vulnerabilities when sharing product ideas with competitors and the need to safeguard innovations better, especially in a market where understanding of MCP gateway products is essential for business success.
